boxes.title: Kings & temples: more
items: Origin also: **V.A. Smith** (foreign), **C.V. Vaidya** (Kshatriya); states rose from ==**Pratihara** collapse==
**Bhojpur** (near Bhopal): unfinished Shiva temple, huge linga, **Bhojpur lake**
Kumarapala curbed animal slaughter; Solankis Shaiva yet patrons of Jainism
Somnath rebuilt by **Mahipala I** after **1299**; =="Old Somnath": **Ahilyabai Holkar**, **1783**==
Bhojshala became mosque, **14th c.**: **Kamal Maula Mosque**
